---
title: Troubleshooting
format: md
---

**URLs look wrong?**
- Check the institution's builder in `R/add_course_url.R`
- Print a few: `courses |> filter(institution == "inst") |> add_course_url() |> select(url) |> head()`

**HTML download fails?**
- Check if the website is accessible in a browser
- Count the outcomes: `raw_ledger(harvest_files("inst")) |> dplyr::count(outcome, http_status)`
- Look at `html_error` for error messages
- Some institutions rate-limit or block automated requests
- For NTNU, check whether the page says no information is available

**Extracted text is empty or wrong?**
- Verify the CSS selector with browser dev tools on a real course page
- Update the selector in `R/institution_config.R` if the website changed, then `targets::tar_make()` (no new harvest needed)
- Read one page into blocks and look at them: `page_blocks(html, NA, .block_cfg(get_institution_config("inst")))`
- Some pages have different structures for different years

**Content missing from JavaScript-rendered pages?**
- Shadow DOM content is invisible to `html_text()`; see USN in [Institution-Specific Notes](institutions.md)
- `session$session$Runtime$evaluate("...")` runs JavaScript in a live session
- `session$view()` opens the browser to see what is rendered

**"the site refuses the harvest (HTTP 429 ...)" or "(HTTP 403 ..., 5 in a row; ...)"?**
- The site answered 429, or 403 to 5 requests in a row and then to a page known
  to be public (or no such page was known), so its harvest stopped; the pages fetched so
  far are in the checkpoint. Harvest it again later (the checkpoint resumes),
  at night, or with a longer `request_delay` in `R/institution_config.R`

**Checkpoint folder is large?**
- This is normal - HTML is large; a year's html checkpoint is removed once
  the run of that year and of the next are written
- Checkpoints are in `.gitignore`; deleting one makes the next run fetch again
  the offerings that are not yet in a raw file (never the ones that are)

**"raw files are not written twice"?**
- A run of that name exists: two harvests of the same institution at once
  (two processes), or a run written by hand. The raw store is append-only;
  run the harvest again

**"offerings in more than one raw file"?**
- Two runs of an institution hold the same `course_id` (not a retry); a file
  was copied into `data/raw/` by hand. Remove the copy
